record.original_question: Let M be a smooth real hypersurface in C^n with defining function r. Let p0 be a point in M, and let U be a neighborhood in C^n of p0 . When do C-R functions on M ∩ U extend to {r > 0}?

evidence.quote: Problem 3.1.1 Let M be a smooth real hypersurface in Cn with defining function r. Let p0 be a point in M, and let U be a neighborhood in Cn of p0 . When do C-R functions on M ∩ U extend to {r > 0}? -B. Stensones, berit@math.lsa.umich.edu 3.2 The Future Tube 3.3 Schlichtness of envelopes of holomorphy

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $M$ be a smooth real hypersurface in $\mathbb{C}^n$ ($n \geq 2$) with smooth defining function $r$, so that locally $M = \{z \in \mathbb{C}^n : r(z) = 0\}$ with $dr \neq 0$ on $M$. Fix a point $p_0 \in M$ and a neighborhood $U \subset \mathbb{C}^n$ of $p_0$. A continuous function $f$ on $M \cap U$ is called a CR function if it satisfies the tangential Cauchy–Riemann equations $\bar{L} f = 0$ (in the distributional sense) for every smooth section $\bar{L}$ of $T^{0,1} M$ over $M \cap U$.

Give geometric conditions on $M$ at $p_0$ (in terms of the Levi form, finite-type conditions, or other local invariants of the CR structure of $M$) that are necessary and sufficient so that, for every CR function $f$ on $M \cap U$, there exists a (possibly smaller) neighborhood $V \subset U$ of $p_0$ and a holomorphic function $F$ on $V \cap \{r > 0\}$ such that $F$ extends continuously to $V \cap (\{r > 0\} \cup M)$ with $F|_{V \cap M} = f|_{V \cap M}$.
artifact.status_search_result: Classical sufficient conditions for one-sided holomorphic extension of CR functions are known: if the Levi form of $r$ has a negative eigenvalue at $p_0$, then all CR functions extend to the side $\{r>0\}$ (Lewy-type theorems). More generally, results of Trépreau, Tumanov, Baouendi–Treves, and others give extension under minimality and finite-type hypotheses. A complete necessary-and-sufficient geometric characterization for one-sided extension to a fixed side in the smooth (non-real-analytic) case remains an active research topic, so the problem as posed is partially solved.

status_evidence.title: Holomorphic Extension of CR Functions: A Survey
status_evidence.snippet: Survey on holomorphic extension of CR functions from real hypersurfaces and submanifolds, covering Lewy, Trépreau, Tumanov results.
status_evidence.claim: The one-sided extension problem has a substantial body of partial results based on Levi form signature and minimality.

status_evidence.title: 3.4: Extension of CR Functions - LibreTexts
status_evidence.snippet: If the Levi form with respect to r has a positive eigenvalue at p, then a smooth CR function f extends to a holomorphic function on the negative side; if negative eigenvalue, extends to positive side; if mixed signs, extends to both.
status_evidence.claim: Sufficient conditions for one-sided extension are classically known via the Levi form.
